default/30760.htm.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: How do you do, young one! I am Sir Gustav Athebaldt, loyal knight of the royal bodyguards. I know what you're thinking, and while my bones may be creaking from years of fighting, I still have plenty of fight left in me. See, the future of our nation cannot be left to the capri…

Q00193_SevenSignsDyingMessage/30760-01.h.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Aha! The good priest told me about you! As fast as your legs are, nothing spreads faster than gossip my friend! So you're here for your reward are you? Let's see what I can dig out for you....
when: state STARTED; cond 6

links.text: "Actually I came to offer my services, but I won't say no to a reward."

Q00194_SevenSignsMammonsContract/30760-0.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Ready are you? Well then, let's get to it! I'm sure you're full to the brim with questions, but allow me first to tell you a short story. My tale should answer your questions before they are asked, give you context to what you have already witnessed, and show you your path if …
when: state CREATED; ((player.getLevel() >= MIN_LEVEL) && player.hasQuestCompleted(Q00193_SevenSignsDyingMessage.class.ge

links.text: "Yes. I promised Priest Cain I'd work with you."

Q00194_SevenSignsMammonsContract/30760-0.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: (Only characters who are level 79 or higher and who have completed the Seven Signs and Dying Message quests may undertake this quest.)
when: state CREATED; NOT ((player.getLevel() >= MIN_LEVEL) && player.hasQuestCompleted(Q00193_SevenSignsDyingMessage.class.ge

Q00194_SevenSignsMammonsContract/30760-0.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Good, very good! One thing the Order can never have too much of is talented individuals such as yourself. Now, this story. Let's start back at the very beginning, shall we? Emperor Shunaiman unifies Aden, and brings peace to a world that had for centuries been ravaged by war, …
when: state STARTED; cond 1

Q00194_SevenSignsMammonsContract/30760-0.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: No doubt, but time is not something we have to spare, my friend. Now listen. Our agents have succeeded in gathering all but the last page of this contract. We believe this last page has the secret agreement penned in it, the one we seek to uncover. We need help. We need someon…
when: state STARTED; cond 2

Q00194_SevenSignsMammonsContract/30760-0.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Hurry along to Agent Collin , won't you? He won't wait for you forever, you know. Hurry! Oren's South Entrance !
when: state STARTED; cond 3

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30760-01.html.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Were you sent by Magister Hannelin? I've been expecting you! Please, hurry and give me the items before someone sees you! She was going to send me three pieces of "the blood of the angel"... Is this it?! Ha! What a novel idea. I didn't know what to expect when she spoke of blo…
when: state STARTED; item 4295 >= 3; st.getMemoStateEx(0) == 18; (st.getMemoStateEx(1) % 2) == 0

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30760-02.html.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Did Magister Hanellin send you? Good! I've been waiting for you! Quickly, before anybody sees us! Please give me the three units of angel's blood that I ordered! Isn't it original? Ah, blood soaked fabric, eh? Very ingenious! But this fabric couldn't possibly contain the three…
when: state STARTED; st.getMemoStateEx(0) == 18; (st.getMemoStateEx(1) % 2) == 0; !getQuestItemsCount(player, BLOODED_FABRIC) >= 3

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/30760-03.html.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: What else can I do for you? You have already given me the three red pieces of fabric, right? We won't talk about how they got to be red, all right? We shouldn't be seen together, there are spies all around us...
when: state STARTED; st.getMemoStateEx(0) == 18; !(st.getMemoStateEx(1) % 2) == 0; (st.getMemoStateEx(1) % 2) == 1

Just look at the peasants' uprising in Dion a few years ago; past generations wouldn't have dared dream of such things, and yet... here we are. The uprising planted seeds, see, and now a number of groups are preparing to …

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-09.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: You must hurry to the Town of Giran and meet with Martien . Do whatever he says, and go prepared!
when: state STARTED; memo 1000; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-10.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: How are things going with Martien? I have his report right here, and by the sounds of it you and your clan are doing well. Just never forget the responsibilities you shoulder now, towards the whole of Aden.
when: state STARTED; memo 2000; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-11t.h.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Martien tells me that you have completed the first stage of the plan. Now you and your clan are needed elsewhere. Please have your clan lord come and see me in the next few days.
when: state STARTED; memo 3000; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null; !player.isClanLeader()

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-11.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: I have just received Martien's report. I have given compensation to the families of the dead Dwarves, but it still pains me to see good men in my employ meet their end under my watch. Today is truly a sad day.... At least their suffering was not in vaun: the first part of my p…
when: state STARTED; memo 3000; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null; player.isClanLeader()

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-13.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: You must hurry to Balthazar with the letter I gave you. He can be found in Hunters Village .
when: state STARTED; memo 4000; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-14.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Although Balthazar is not well-known in Dwarven society, he is an incredibly talented Artisan, and now it seems that his efforts will finally bear fruit. Your clan will be a great help to him; I also expect that the results of his research will be of great use to you....
when: state STARTED; memo 5000; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-15t.h.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: I have heard of the great help that you and your clan have given to Balthazar... thank you. Now why didn't you bring your clan leader with you? I must meet with him to ask for his help with something.
when: state STARTED; memo 6000; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null; !player.isClanLeader()

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-15.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: I have heard that your clan has been a great help to Balthazar... thank you. I hate to bring this up so soon after your return, but the next part of your mission awaits. Are you ready?
when: state STARTED; memo 6000; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null; player.isClanLeader()

links.text: "What is the next part of the mission?"

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-17.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: You must find the Scepter of Judgment and secure it before it falls into the wrong hands. Go and see Sir Eric Rodemai in the Town of Aden . Give him the letter I gave you and he will tell you what to do next.
when: state STARTED; memo 7000; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-18.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: I hear that you have met with Sir Rodemai. As you know, you must find the Scepter of Judgment . If it falls into the hands of our rivals, it will bring chaos and destruction to all that we know.
when: state STARTED; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null; qs.getMemoState() >= 8000; qs.getMemoState() < 8700

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-19.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Wonderful work! You managed to obtain the Scepter of Judgment ! Now quick... hand it over!
when: state STARTED; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null; !((qs.getMemoState() >= 8000) && (qs.getMemoState() < 8700)); qs.getMemoState() >= 8700

links.text: "What do you intend to do with it?"

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-19t.h.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Wonderful! You were able to secure the Scepter of Judgement! Where is your clan leader, by the way? I trust he wasn't hurt?
when: state STARTED; memo 9000; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null; !((qs.getMemoState() >= 8000) && (qs.getMemoState() < 8700)); !((qs.getMemoState() >= 8700) && (qs.getMemoState() < 10000) && player.isClanLeader())

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-24t.h.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Go and tell your clan leader that he must relinquish the scepter immediately. It is of no use to your clan. If he values his own life and that of his clan he will comply.
when: state STARTED; memo 10000; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null; !((qs.getMemoState() >= 8000) && (qs.getMemoState() < 8700)); !((qs.getMemoState() >= 8700) && (qs.getMemoState() < 10000) && player.isClanLeader())

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-24.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: An elder knows when to change his mind; a child does not. What were you thinking by refusing me the scepter? You must have known that you couldn't keep it from me--I am destined to possess it.
when: state STARTED; memo 10000; !(qs.isCreated() || qs.isCompleted()); lqs != null; !((qs.getMemoState() >= 8000) && (qs.getMemoState() < 8700)); !((qs.getMemoState() >= 8700) && (qs.getMemoState() < 10000) && player.isClanLeader())

Q00193_SevenSignsDyingMessage/30760-02.h.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Ha! Good! I don't trust people who turn down money. Means they've already been paid, usually, and THAT means they aren't in my employ. Ah yes, here. I believe this should be about right. Now, there's much I need to tell you, but a man's ears are near useless when his stomach's…

Q00194_SevenSignsMammonsContract/30760-0.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: As most do. But many are not aware of a great battle that bubbles under the surface, between our order and the Order of Dusk . We fight for control over the Seven Seals , the seals Shunaiman himself created to fight Shilen and her armies. These seals are now buried deep in Ade…

Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Aye, but what you don't see is one of Aden's most closely guarded secrets. You see, Emperor Shunaiman's rise to supremacy was not a smooth transition, and in his darkest hours Aden's greatest Emperor turned to some unlikely sources....

Sir Gustav Athebaldt: We do--the Priests of Dawn hold the page. One of our spies was able to find the document, but was discovered and killed before we could spirit him away. I want you to go in his place, infiltrate the Priests of Dawn and steal the last page of that contract . We'll train you up …

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-05.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Yes, I agree. But first I must ask you a question: why do you wish to seek your clan? As clan leader, what is it that you truly desire? Answer truly.

links.text: "I want to make our lands safe for future generations."
"I want to have my remembered for all time."

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-06.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Ha... you remind me of myself when I was young. But this world is not so easily conquered my friend.... I believe that you have what it takes to be a capable leader, and I'm sure things will work out for the best. Now though... now you must help me prepare for my mission.

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-07.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Then you must never show your true feelings; a leader with as many followers as you must keep their private opinions to themselves. You have shown much potential, so now I will tell you how you can help me.

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-08.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Right now, Giran is very unhapppy because of the Land Dragon Antharas. It's understandable because rumor has it Antharas is awake again. The ones in power in Giran, the nobles and merchants, are discussing ridiculous solutions about hiring mercenaries and such. The fools.... Y…

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-12.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: History shows us again and again that ultimate power, complete domination comes most often to those with the superior technology. It's because of that that I have long supported the Black Anvil guild. Their mission is to research the ancient technology of the giants, technolog…

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-16.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Much has transpired since then. Dire warnings of global destruction and chaos are rife throughout the land. A force has been dispatched to deal with Antharas, and evil spirits are wreaking havoc in several parts of the kingdom. Warlords are battling against each other for the …

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-20.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: Well, our time together has finally come to an end. I pray that one day your clan will become strong enough to establish peace on this continent, but fear that it will take a great many deaths before peace can be established here. Now I bestow upon your clan the Seal of Aspira…

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-21.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: I see from your face that Sir Rodemai has been talking about me.... Please don't misunderstand my intentions; When King Rauhel was alive, I served him faithfully, and I have been as truthful with you as I thought I could be, but I believe my country needs a strong ruler such a…

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-22.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: You are an... an idiot! How can you be so short-sighted! What a hypocrite! I certainly judged you wrong! Even now the Black Legion is coming for this, and you will be powerless to fight back. They will wash over you like the incoming tide, and when they have what they want the…

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30760-23.ht.text: Sir Gustav Athebaldt: I suppose I misjudged you. We all seek what we think is most important. Here you go. Take the Seal of Aspiration --it will bring you one step closer to your dream.
